name: Niki BioSolutions Inc.
summary: Niki BioSolutions is a biopharmaceutical company that resulted from the merger of Aptorum Group and DiamiR Biosciences. The company focuses on developing and commercializing a diverse portfolio of therapeutic and diagnostic assets. Its work spans from treatments for diseases with unmet medical needs, particularly in oncology and infectious diseases, to the development of innovative, blood-based diagnostic tests for brain health and other conditions.
